generation_balance_shortfall.meaning: negative units are second changes spotted by polling the registry while an older one is still queued, which coalesced_changes does not count; no cost, delivery or outcome identity is affected

units_note.bytes_per_emission_batch: airtime / emissions -- what one send opportunity cost
units_note.bytes_per_receiver_packet: airtime / transmission attempts -- what one packet to one robot cost
units_note.on_time_rate_per_episode_mean: per-episode on_time / that episode's detected targets, in [0, 1]
units_note.on_time_targets_per_episode_mean: targets completed before their deadline, per episode, then averaged
units_note.pooled_on_time_over_detected_targets: total on_time / total detected targets; a different number from either mean above
